title: Authorization: Bearer <key> accepted (undocumented auth scheme)
steps_to_reproduce:
Send POST https://tts.us.assemblyai.com/v1/speech with header:
Authorization: Bearer ***redacted***
Result: 200 OK — speech synthesized.
impact: Undocumented auth variant accepted server-side. Masking misconfigurations in client applications and expanding the attack surface for auth parsing bugs.
remediation: Explicitly reject keys prefixed with 'Bearer ' if the documented format is raw key only, or formally document and test both schemes.

title: Authorization: bearer <key> (lowercase) accepted
steps_to_reproduce:
Send POST https://tts.us.assemblyai.com/v1/speech with header:
Authorization: bearer ***redacted***
Result: 200 OK — speech synthesized.
impact: Case-insensitive prefix parsing confirms ad-hoc auth header handling logic rather than strict schema enforcement.
remediation: Enforce strict schema validation on Authorization headers.

title: Authorization header with trailing whitespace accepted (silently trimmed)
steps_to_reproduce:
Send Authorization: ***redacted***<SPACE>
Result: 200 OK (key silently trimmed server-side).
impact: Overly-permissive header parsing masks malformed client credentials and makes boundary validation inconsistent.
remediation: Reject keys with surrounding whitespace rather than silently trimming.

title: Duplicate Authorization header accepted by speech endpoint
steps_to_reproduce:
Send two Authorization headers in a single HTTP request.
Result: 200 OK — request accepted.
impact: In reverse-proxy, API gateway, or CDN architectures, accepting duplicate headers can lead to request-smuggling auth bypass if intermediate proxies inspect a different header than the origin server.
remediation: Reject requests containing more than one Authorization header with 400 Bad Request.

title: API silently ignores unrecognised request parameters (x-tts-unknown-params)
steps_to_reproduce:
Send request body with nested 'output_format': {'container': 'mp3', ...}.
Response status: 200 OK with header 'x-tts-unknown-params: output_format'. Server silently defaulted to raw PCM instead of requested MP3.
impact: Clients receive unintended audio formats without error notifications. Parameter validation allowlist silently discards unrecognized fields rather than enforcing strict request contracts, masking misconfigurations.
remediation: Return 400 Bad Request when unknown parameters are passed.

title: server-timing header exposes internal pipeline stage durations
steps_to_reproduce:
Send any valid TTS synthesis request.
Response header: server-timing: open;dur=37.5, model;dur=86.6, ttfa;dur=124.2
impact: Leaks internal architecture and stage names ('open', 'model', 'ttfa'). Enables timing-attack oracles to infer model internals, measure text complexity, or test voice existence via inference duration.
remediation: Remove server-timing from production API responses or restrict to internal monitoring headers.

title: x-tts-voice-expires-at header leaks internal token lease timestamp
steps_to_reproduce:
Send POST /v1/speech with valid voice_id.
Response header: x-tts-voice-expires-at: 1799232239
impact: Discloses internal lifecycle and expiry timing of underlying storage or voice access credentials.
remediation: Omit internal credential expiry timestamps from client-facing response headers.

title: Auth error codes differentiate missing header from invalid key (Oracle)
steps_to_reproduce:
No header -> 401 code: 'missing_authorization'
Wrong key -> 401 code: 'unauthorized'
impact: Allows attackers to distinguish whether an authorization header reached the validation engine versus early filtering.
remediation: Return consistent error response schemas across all authentication failure modes.

title: x-tts-region leaks backend cloud region on unauthenticated responses
steps_to_reproduce:
Send unauthenticated request (401 response).
Response header: x-tts-region: us-east-1
impact: Discloses AWS infrastructure hosting region to unauthenticated scanners.
remediation: Only return routing metadata on authenticated requests.

title: timing-allow-origin: * exposes synthesis performance metrics cross-origin
steps_to_reproduce: Observe response headers on POST /v1/speech: timing-allow-origin: *
impact: Allows third-party websites to extract timing metrics for cross-origin TTS calls via the Resource Timing API.
remediation: Restrict timing-allow-origin to authorized dashboard origins.
